name: FastChat-T5
description:
Here is how to read the FastChat-T5 config.json. The architecture class is T5ForConditionalGeneration, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 2,048: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 32,110 × 2,048: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 32, so each head sees 64 dimensions (2,048 / 32). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 2048 / 32 = 64. 64 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_hidden_layers is 24: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

vocab_size is 32,110. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

tie_word_embeddings is false, so the input embedding matrix and the output LM head are separate learned matrices rather than a shared transpose.

torch_dtype is float16.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/lmsys/fastchat-t5-3b-v1.0/blob/main/config.json.
